de1.P2.C3.ly_do: a Sai (a = (3;-4;1), khong phai (3;4;14)); b Sai (B = A + a = (6;0;-1), khong phai (0;0;12)); d Sai (diem M gan A nhat thoa dien tich bang 12 nam cach A chua toi 0,4 nen tong toa do khong the bang 98).
de1.P2.C3.ghi_chu: Menh de c trong file chi con manh OCR vo nghia (ten vecto thanh so) nen khong khoi phuc duoc — can de goc.

de1.P2.C4.ly_do: a Dung theo dinh nghia (khoang tu phan vi la hieu Q3 - Q1); b, c, d thieu so lieu nen chua cham.
de1.P2.C4.ghi_chu: Hai o tan so (nhom [8;11) va [14;17)) trong file bi loi OCR thanh manh vo nghia nen khong tinh duoc Q3 va khoang tu phan vi; hon nua c va d khong the cung dung — can bang goc.
